trace.command:
cd /tmp; npm install -g /mnt/session/uploads/noacg-cli.tgz >/dev/null 2>&1; noacg --version
export NOACG_URL=https://noacg.studio
mkdir -p ~/.pki/nssdb && (certutil -d sql:$HOME/.pki/nssdb -N --empty-password 2>/dev/null; for c in /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/*.crt; do certutil -d sql:$HOME/.pki/nssdb -A -t C,, -n "$(basename "$c")" -i "$c"; done)
noacg doctor; noacg types

cd /workspace && export NOACG_URL=https://noacg.studio && noacg scaffold --type scoreboard --design neutral --out ./graphic 2>&1 | tail -20; cd graphic; ls -R | head -30; cat *.html; cat css/template.css; cat js/template.js

cd /workspace/graphic; sed -i 's/font-size: calc(20px \* var(--scale) \* var(--type-scale));\n  font-weight: 800;\n  letter-spacing: 0.18em/X/' css/template.css; python3 - <<'EOF'
p='css/template.css'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("font-size: calc(20px * var(--scale) * var(--type-scale));\n  font-weight: 800;\n  letter-spacing: 0.18em;","font-size: calc(24px * var(--scale) * var(--type-scale));\n  font-weight: 800;\n  letter-spacing: 0.16em;")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
ls; noacg validate . --screenshots ../shots 2>&1 | head -5

cd /workspace/graphic; python3 - <<'EOF'
p='css/template.css'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("  margin-left: calc(14px * var(--scale));\n","  width: max-content;\n  margin-left: calc(14px * var(--scale));\n",1)
s=s.replace("""  left: 0; right: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0;
  background: var(--accent);
  opacity: 0;""","""  left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0;
  width: calc(10px * var(--scale));   /* a marker on the scoring row's edge */
  background: var(--accent);
  opacity: 0;""")
s=s.replace(".scoreboard-final .scoreboard-status {\n  color: var(--accent);\n}\n.scoreboard-final .scoreboard-accent { height: calc(10px * var(--scale)); }",
".scoreboard-final .scoreboard-status-mask { background: var(--accent); border-radius: calc(8px * var(--scale)) calc(8px * var(--scale)) 0 0; }\n.scoreboard-final .scoreboard-status { color: var(--flag-text); }\n.scoreboard-final .scoreboard-accent { opacity: 0; }")
s=s.replace(".scoreboard-status-mask { padding: calc(14px * var(--scale)) calc(20px * var(--scale)) calc(4px * var(--scale)); }",".scoreboard-status-mask { padding: calc(12px * var(--scale)) calc(20px * var(--scale)) calc(4px * var(--scale)); }")
open(p,'w').write(s)
j=open('js/template.js').read()
j=j.replace('"opacity":[\n','"opacity":[\n')
open('js/template.js','w').write(j)
EOF
grep -n 'scoreboard-glow-a' js/template.js; noacg screenshot --help 2>&1 | head -30

cd /workspace/graphic; export NOACG_URL=https://noacg.studio; mkdir -p ../s2
noacg screenshot . --data f0="ST MARY'S SCHOOL" --data f1=3 --data f2=RIVERSIDE --data f3=1 --event goalB --event final --background video --out ../s2/final.png 2>&1 | tail -2
noacg screenshot . --data f0="ST MARY'S SCHOOL" --data f1=3 --data f2=RIVERSIDE --data f3=1 --event goalB --at 1 --background video --out ../s2/goalb.png 2>&1 | tail -2

cd /workspace/graphic; python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
j=open('js/template.js').read()
j=re.sub(r'(".scoreboard-glow-[ab]": \{\s*"opacity": \[\s*\{ "time": 0, "value": )0\.45( \},\s*\{ "time": 0\.9, "value": )0\.14',r'\g<1>0.5\g<2>1',j)
j=j.replace('{ "time": 0, "value": 0.14 },','{ "time": 0, "value": 1 },')
open('js/template.js','w').write(j)
c=open('css/template.css').read()
c+=".scoreboard-final .scoreboard-flag,\n.scoreboard-final .scoreboard-glow { visibility: hidden; }  /* full time ends the goal moment */\n"
open('css/template.css','w').write(c)
EOF
grep -n '"value": 0.5\|"value": 1 }' js/template.js | sed -n 1,12p
export NOACG_URL=https://noacg.studio
noacg validate . --screenshots ../shots 2>&1 | head -8; noacg inspect . 2>&1 | tail -30

cd /workspace/graphic; grep -n '"value": 0.5' js/template.js; export NOACG_URL=https://noacg.studio
noacg record /workspace/graphic --out /mnt/session/outputs/record.json 2>&1 | tail -3
noacg coverage /workspace/graphic --out /mnt/session/outputs/coverage 2>&1 | tail -5; python3 -c "
import json;d=json.load(open('/mnt/session/outputs/coverage/coverage.json'));print(json.dumps(d,indent=0)[:3000])"

cd /workspace/graphic; python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
j=open('js/template.js').read()
j,n1=re.subn(r'("time": 0,\s*"value": )0\.45',r'\g<1>0.5',j)
j,n2=re.subn(r'("time": 0\.9,\s*"value": )0\.14',r'\g<1>1',j)
j,n3=re.subn(r'("time": 0,\s*"value": )0\.14',r'\g<1>1',j)
print(n1,n2,n3)
open('js/template.js','w').write(j)
EOF
export NOACG_URL=https://noacg.studio
noacg validate . 2>&1 | head -3
noacg record /workspace/graphic --out /mnt/session/outputs/record.json 2>&1 | tail -2
rm -rf /mnt/session/outputs/coverage; noacg coverage /workspace/graphic --out /mnt/session/outputs/coverage 2>&1 | head -1
